input.quote: 5.8.1 Harpoon shall not, and shall cause its Affiliates not to (a) directly or indirectly, develop, commercialize or otherwise exploit any Competing Product in any country or other jurisdiction in the Territory, or (b) license, authorize, appoint, or otherwise enable any Third Party to directly or indirectly, develop, commercialize or otherwise exploit any Competing Product in any country or other jurisdiction in the Territory, except, in each case ((a) and (b)), as otherwise expressly provided in this Agreement.
input.rationale: The only exclusivity/non-compete covenant in the Agreement is Section 5.8 ("Exclusivity with Respect to the Territory"), which binds Harpoon (the counterparty) and its Affiliates not to develop or commercialize Competing Products; the Section 5.8.2 Acquisition/Change of Control carve-outs, Segregation requirement and AbbVie information-cut-off right all operate in our favour. AbbVie's covenants (Section 10.4) are limited to obtaining IP rights from its Affiliates, Sublicensees and personnel, and Articles 4 and 5 confer sole Commercialization, sublicensing, distribution and co-promotion discretion on AbbVie rather than restricting it. A targeted search for "compet", "Competing Product", "AbbVie shall not", "neither Party shall" and "directly or indirectly" found no non-compete, exclusivity or field-of-use covenant restricting AbbVie's business, products or programs, in-term or post-term. The Field/Territory limits on the licences granted to AbbVie are grant-scope provisions, not restrictive covenants. This meets the preferred position (no non-compete or field-of-use restriction on the Customer), so no redline is proposed.
